$comment: Frozen baselines for the dotnet/maui -> Maui.Tizen extraction.
Every ref here is a pinned commit SHA or an exact version string, never a branch
name. origin/net11.0 advanced from ee4d06cde6 to bedd1b18b7 during the few hours
the initial import was prepared, which is exactly why branch names are unusable
as baselines.
Consumed by eng/import/filter-maui-tizen.sh and by the inventory/API baseline
tooling. Changing any value here invalidates the generated baselines and should
be accompanied by regenerating them.

sourceBaseline.role: Forward source baseline. All net11-era Tizen sources are taken from here.

$comment: net11.0 continued past this pin. The commits below touch Tizen paths and are
therefore NOT represented in the import or in any baseline generated from it.
All three touch ONLY src/Controls/src/Core/PublicAPI/net-tizen/PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt
- they are API surface declarations, not implementation - so the practical gap is
that the Controls net-tizen Unshipped baseline is three API additions behind
current net11.0. This matters for API baseline diffing, not for source migration.
Recorded because 'we pinned a SHA' is only reproducible if what the pin EXCLUDES
is also written down.
knownGapAfterThisPin.$note: bedd1b18b7 is also developmentPackageBaseline.nuspecRepositoryCommit, so the Microsoft.Maui.* packages this repository compiles against DO contain these three API additions while the imported source baseline does not. The gap therefore applies to imported source only.

commits.title: Harden gesture recognizer dispatch API contracts

requiredAncestor.title: [Extensibility] Essentials: Bridge DI implementations to static facades
requiredAncestor.role: Minimum API floor. The import script hard-fails if this is not an ancestor of sourceBaseline.
requiredAncestor.note: This commit is NOT on dotnet/maui main. It lives on net11.0 and release/11.0.1xx-rc1.

behaviorBaseline.note: This is the ONLY ref that still carries src/Compatibility Tizen sources (70 files). They were deleted upstream on net11.0, so a net11.0-only baseline loses them silently.

developmentPackageBaseline.role: Coherent public-feed MAUI package set for net11. Used when building against published MAUI packages rather than source.
$comment: IMPORTANT: this is a DIFFERENT commit from sourceBaseline, and deliberately so.
sourceBaseline               ee4d06cde6   what the history import is pinned to
nuspecRepositoryCommit       bedd1b18b7   what these packages were built from
bedd1b18b7 is 46 commits ahead of ee4d06cde6 and INCLUDES the three Tizen-touching
commits recorded in sourceBaseline.knownGapAfterThisPin (#37420, #37671, #37755).
So the gap is one-directional and applies only to imported SOURCE, not to the
packages we compile against: the referenced Microsoft.Maui.* assemblies already
carry those three API additions, while the imported PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt
baseline does not. Anyone diffing our API baselines against these packages should
expect exactly that delta and should not read it as drift.

aspNetCoreDependencyFloor.note: Declared by Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebView.Maui's own nuspec at this package version, and unchanged by the MAUI bump. ASP.NET Core packages are on their own version line and must NOT be moved to the MAUI stamp - that version does not exist for them.

target.$comment: The workload contract this repository builds against.

$comment: Naming matters here and is easy to get wrong. NuGet package IDs are
case-insensitive, so this appears in both spellings in the wild:
Samsung.NET.Sdk.Tizen.Manifest-<band>   (Samsung's own casing)
samsung.net.sdk.tizen.manifest-<band>   (nuget.org flat-container form)
The <band> suffix is the SDK feature band, and for previews it carries the
preview segment too - so what to watch for is the -preview.7 form, not a bare
11.0.100. Both were probed; neither exists.
workloadManifest.note: Neither the '-11.0.100' nor the '-11.0.100-preview.7' form exists on nuget.org (both 404). Only the 9.0.100 and 10.0.100 bands publish, and the newest Samsung.Tizen.Sdk is 10.0.128. Explicit external gate: net11.0-tizen11.0 cannot be restored or built anywhere until Samsung publishes an 11.0.100-band manifest. See docs/migration.md.
